This is the implementation launch, not issuer founding or parent-token launch.

collateral: USDC-denominated Morpho lending claims on Base, concentrated in a cbBTC-collateralized market; the lender vault does not directly hold the borrowers' cbBTC collateral.
pegMechanism: Deposit USDC to mint ERC-4626 lending-vault shares. Lending interest net of fees increases USDC per share; redemption burns shares and withdraws available Morpho liquidity. MetaMorpho V1.1 does not immediately reduce the reported share price after market bad debt: its lostAssets accounting can leave the last depositors bearing the shortfall unless assets are voluntarily injected.

notices.title: Last-exiter loss exposure
notices.message: Morpho V1.1 can retain the reported share price after market bad debt. Later withdrawals may be unable to realize that accounting value unless someone voluntarily covers the loss. This is a design risk, not a claim of current bad debt; lostAssets was zero at the October 15 review.
